title: Performance validation for drag/zoom and JSON import
description: Implement performance benchmarks and validation tests to verify PRD non-functional performance requirements: drag/zoom feedback ≤ 100 ms with 50 tables, JSON import ≤ 1 s for a 50-table file on a mid-range laptop.
acceptanceCriteria: Benchmark measures drag/zoom feedback latency with a 50-table diagram
Benchmark measures JSON import time for a 50-table fixture file
Tests assert drag/zoom ≤ 100 ms and JSON import ≤ 1 s
Performance tests run in Docker (node:20-alpine) and report results

statusHistory.reason: Ticket created from PRD NFR Performance requirements (drag/zoom ≤ 100 ms, JSON import ≤ 1 s)
